extractions.value: Diagnosis criteria of stiff-person syndrome (SPS) include progressive, fluctuating muscular rigidity and spasms with normal neurological examination. The presence of unusual features such as prominent limb rigidity with segmental signs and contracture, evidence of brainstem dysfunction, profound autonomic disturbances, CSF pleiocytosis or MRI abnormalities in patients with SPS presentation allows to classify these patients as progressive encephalomyelitis with rigidity (PER).
